title: Argentine Morning Glory Braise
description: A unique and flavorful braise made with morning glory and a hint of spicy jalapeño, inspired by Argentine cuisine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced jalapeño and cook for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the morning glory and cook for 5 minutes until slightly tender.
Add the braising liquid and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes until the morning glory is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
